observed_issue: In-progress checkpoint audit found two index/content mismatches because an active run record and log changed after their hashes were captured. Archive CRC passed; this was a metadata race, not corrupted training data or weights.
resolution: Stream each member from one open file handle and hash exactly the bytes written; serialize the content index last. Exclude temporary model serialization files.
final_verification: Final deliverable must pass every member hash plus fresh inference in a separately extracted directory.
